official: 港区職員の分限に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 条件付採用職員の降任・免職事由を追加
summary: 港区職員の分限に関する条例を改正します。条件付採用期間中の職員を降任・免職できる事由を定め、令和8年4月1日から施行します。
changes: 勤務実績がよくない場合を降任・免職の事由に加える
心身の故障で職務に支障がある場合を事由に加える
職に必要な適格性を欠く場合を事由に加える
降任・免職の手続に関する規定を準用する
who: 条件付採用期間中の職員
why: 条件付採用期間中の職員の分限に係る事由を定めるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds grounds for demotion or dismissal of probationary employees
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Minato City Ordinance Concerning the Status of City Employees
en.summary: Amends the Minato City Ordinance Concerning the Status of City Employees. It establishes grounds for demoting or dismissing employees during their probationary appointment period and takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Adds poor work performance as a ground for demotion or dismissal
Adds a physical or mental condition that interferes with job duties as a ground
Adds lack of the qualifications required for the position as a ground
Applies the provisions on demotion and dismissal procedures
who: Employees during their probationary appointment period
en.why: The ward says this is to establish grounds for status-related decisions concerning employees during their probationary appointment period.
